reference_platform: BlueROV2 Heavy, a tethered ROV; not a validated AUV digital twin
model_status: Literature-parameter Gazebo engineering port; no real-vehicle validation
engineering_approximations: Displacement volume represented by one collision box at the buoyancy center; exterior is simplified visual geometry, not CAD collision geometry.
Rotor masses/inertias are numerical joint components; total mass/CG/inertia are corrected to the literature values.
Rounded installation angles and the horizontal direction angles are transcribed from Table A1, including its 3pi/4 third angle; do not treat them as verified manufacturer CAD.
15 N symmetric derated test envelope, 0.12 s lag, slew limit and controller gains are engineering test choices, not identified manufacturer curves.
Gazebo Newton-command thrusters use a nominal 0.01 thrust coefficient for angular-speed conversion; no validated PWM, RPM, propeller reaction torque or power curve.
No tether, flow, sensor noise, battery or thrust-interaction model; this is not a reproduction of all paper experiments.
